title: Grid Lifecycle
intent: Create, revise, selectively remove, and recreate Cartesian or Polar grid directions.
useWhen: Use this recipe when reference lines need direction-specific values or appearance instead of guide defaults.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe when the chart has no compatible scale or when grid lines would add clutter without aiding comparison.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

outcomes: Create, revise, selectively remove, and recreate Cartesian or Polar grid directions.

steps.instruction: Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable grid lifecycle result or workflow.
Choose only the focused grid lifecycle components required by the task; mutually exclusive creation alternatives are demonstrated as independent chart variants.

pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
